source: Cases for human_ask.py rules shared with cheese-work/multica-dotfiles (CHE-2597). 'refuse' lists the [line, message] pairs the slice 1 rules (addressee mention, opening lines) must produce; other human_ask.py rules are out of this file until slice 2.
